items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1: 98 direct joins rewritten, line-by-line equivalence check 98/98 (only redundant parentheses differ). AC2: rel-join / rel-join-fallback rules with 13 positive controls; old tree flags exactly 98. AC3: 80-name closed inventory with cap. AC4: fallback shapes untouched (R1a fallback tests green).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: path() raises the same TypeError for a None root as the old join; try blocks around the rewritten sites catch the same exceptions.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input, path or secret handling; the symlink-escape helper in _test_gate_paths is untouched and listed for R1c.

items.name: Code Quality
items.note: Mechanical AST codemod with byte offsets; a regex paren cleanup broke 3 call sites and was caught by ruff and repaired; ruff clean; scan 238 lines, guard test 215 lines.

items.name: Test Coverage
items.note: Guard positive controls for every new shape, a negative control on the old tree, the full F0 suite as the equivalence net (behaviour unchanged).

items.name: Scope
items.note: Indirect joins, constants, fallbacks and path() read/write semantics are written into BRIEF 12 item 10 for R1c, not built here.
